title: Victoria and Butchart Gardens Private Tour for Two
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour is a full day tour with early morning departure with a pick up time at 8:10 am Downtown Vancouver. The type of Tour for Two is the most comfortable way to experience full day in Victoria. Round trip tickets for ferry ride and Butchart Garden entry fees are included in this excursion. 

Before booking this tour please contact us first to check the ferry reservation availability
